listing.name: KMJ Desktop Commander
listing.short_description: Safe autonomous engineering on your own machines and servers.
listing.long_description: Inspect projects, run verified quality gates, make policy-controlled project changes, and coordinate autonomous engineering workflows on customer-controlled development systems without exposing an unrestricted AI root shell.

starter_prompts: Inspect my project and identify the safest highest-priority engineering task.
Run the relevant quality gates and summarize only verified failures.
Fix this safe project issue, retest it, and show the exact evidence.
Show my Git status and explain which changes are safe to continue.
Check this service status without restarting it.

positive_tests.expect: Returns branch/status/stack using a read-only typed tool.
Runs only the allow-listed frontend typecheck gate and returns bounded output.
Reads only a validated relative path within the configured project root.

positive_tests.prompt: Update a project file with this exact content.
positive_tests.expect: Uses atomic project-root write behavior without sudo and reports result.
Uses validated service status operation without a restart.

negative_tests.expect: Denied; no arbitrary/destructive shell is exposed.
Denied until explicit approval and server policy permit the restart.

release_notes: Initial KMJ TECHNO public plugin submission package. Ships branded safe-engineering workflow metadata; public remote MCP publication remains gated on authenticated HTTPS transport, pairing/revocation, security tests, domain verification and signed release identity.
